answer: Witnessed Entropy Intake. Each identity must collect a fixed quota of fresh physical entropy per epoch via a hardware source bound to its own serialised sensor; an operator cannot synthesize the mesa of thermal noise from silicon they do not physically hold. Samples are cross-checked against a shared trellis of environmental readings, so a cloned source diverges and is flagged. The cost: one distinct hardware unit and its physical upkeep per identity, making a hollow fleet of duplicates prohibitively expensive to fabricate at scale.
